items.exampleEn: The baby birds were abandoned by their mother.
items.exampleZh: 那些小鳥被母鳥拋棄了。

items.exampleEn: The new paint transformed the old room.
items.exampleZh: 新油漆讓舊房間煥然一新。

items.exampleEn: The bridge enables people to cross the river quickly.
items.exampleZh: 這座橋讓人們能快速過河。

items.exampleEn: The trip was arranged by our teacher.
items.exampleZh: 這趟旅行是老師安排的。

items.exampleEn: The book explains the life cycle of a frog.
items.exampleZh: 這本書說明青蛙的生命週期。

items.exampleEn: This brave dog deserves a medal.
items.exampleZh: 這隻勇敢的狗應該得到一面獎牌。

items.exampleEn: The line advanced slowly toward the ticket office.
items.exampleZh: 排隊的人龍慢慢地往售票處前進。

items.exampleEn: Can you transfer these photos to my computer?
items.exampleZh: 你可以把這些照片轉移到我的電腦嗎？

items.sentenceEn: We all deserve a second chance.
items.sentenceZh: 我們都值得第二次機會。

items.audioEn: If you want to transfer to another class, please talk to the office before Friday.
items.audioZh: 如果你想轉到別的班，請在星期五前到辦公室談。
options: Go and see the office before Friday.
Talk to the new class on Friday.

items.sentenceEn: Science has advanced a lot in the last fifty years.
items.sentenceZh: 過去五十年來，科學進步了很多。

items.sentenceEn: The seasons follow the same cycle every year.
items.sentenceZh: 四季每年都依照同樣的順序輪流更替。

items.stemEn: The players were tired and cold, so they decided to ____ the game and go home.
items.stemZh: 球員們又累又冷，所以決定放棄比賽回家。

items.stemEn: Can you ____ a meeting with the manager for Monday?
items.stemZh: 你可以安排星期一和經理開會嗎？

items.passageEn: An old factory in our town was abandoned for twenty years. Last year, a group of artists decided to transform it into an art center for local people. A grant from the city enabled them to buy paint and tools. They arranged the big rooms so that each artist had a small studio, and they made one room into a classroom where children learn about the water cycle. Some artists transferred from a center in another city to help. As the work advanced, more and more people joined. Everyone agrees that the artists deserve our thanks.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上有一座舊工廠荒廢了二十年。去年，一群藝術家決定把它改造成給當地人的藝術中心。市政府的補助讓他們能買油漆和各種工具。他們把大房間安排好，讓每位藝術家都有一間小工作室，還把其中一間變成教室，讓孩子學習水在大自然中如何不斷變化。有些藝術家從另一個城市的中心轉過來幫忙。隨著工作進展，越來越多人加入。大家都同意這些藝術家值得我們感謝。

questions.questionZh: 那座舊工廠被改造成什麼？
options: 一座有許多商店的購物中心
一間專門賣二手家具的倉庫

questions.questionZh: 市政府的補助讓藝術家們能做什麼？

items.promptZh: 魔術師把一張紙變成了一隻鳥。
referenceEn: The magician transformed a piece of paper into a bird.
The magician transformed a sheet of paper into a bird.
rubricZh: transform 表示「徹底改變、使轉變」，例如 transform A into B 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 因為天氣太差，他們放棄了爬山的計畫。
referenceEn: They abandoned their plan to climb the mountain because of the bad weather.
Because the weather was bad, they abandoned the climbing plan.
rubricZh: 用 abandon 表示「放棄」（例如 abandoned their plan；寫 gave up 也正確）
